en: A black-and-white vintage image showing a two‑storey manor house with a hipped roof and neoclassical details, including a balustraded terrace and three large arches on the ground floor. The building stands on the far bank of a calm lake or river, its reflection visible in the water. Dense trees and shrubs surround the house, and there are stairways leading from the terrace down toward the water. Tree branches frame the scene in the foreground. The overall look is that of an early 20th‑century European country estate photographed from across the water.
